notes:
DroidFun now offers two models: Meep and Claw.

- Choose Meep or Claw in first setup and when adding a droid. Boo has been retired from new setup; archived artwork and old settings are preserved.
- Codex and Claude use their own animated marks, with their titles lowered slightly for easier viewing inside the droid.
- On Mac, a powered droid shows a smile when all computer displays sleep. Waking a display resumes the current widget. Keep DroidFun running in the background. An awake external monitor keeps live widgets active.
- Existing playlists, per-droid settings and account connections are retained. No firmware replacement is needed for these app changes.

Bot firmware remains 1.2.3 in the customer app. The private owner Workshop is distributed separately and is not part of this release.

Native package tests and installation checks are recorded with the downloads. Physical Mac sleep/wake, long-term USB stability, Intel Mac runtime and multi-droid hardware checks remain separate acceptance items. Mac Developer ID notarization and Windows publisher signing are not configured. Linux updates use the package manager.
